column1: Stir the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt together in a large bowl and make a well in the center.
Whisk the milk, melted butter, vanilla, and egg, then fold into the dry ingredients until mostly smooth.
If the batter is too thick to pour, thin it with a couple tablespoons of milk at a time.
Let the batter rest while a nonstick pan or griddle heats over low-medium heat.
Wipe the pan with a little butter, pour in 1/4 cup batter per pancake, and gently spread into a round.
Flip once the underside is golden and bubbles form on top, then cook until golden on the second side.
Repeat with the remaining batter and serve warm with your favorite toppings.
